title.zh: 代码共同方案的全局支持
title.en: Global support of coded joint plans

claim.zh: 代码方案经原生提升后，在 Within 与 Separate 下，其全部叶项请求受原生整体覆盖且无重复。
claim.en: After native lifting, a coded joint plan’s combined leaf requests are covered by the native whole without duplication under Within and Separate.

hypotheses.zh: joint_plan_lifts 的全部前提，以及支持 F 的包含、排他和叶项正确性。
hypotheses.en: All joint_plan_lifts premises plus footprint containment, exclusivity and leaf correctness.

correspondence.zh: 这是同一模型和叶项解释内的实际形式组合，不是可加预算与任意时序模型的通用转换。
correspondence.en: This is formal composition within the same model and leaf interpretation, not a universal adapter to additive budgets or arbitrary temporal models.

detail.en: Code realization first lifts to the same native joint plan.

next_delta.en: Reuse the existing two-stage composition instead of reproving leaf support; identify the same native relation in applications.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述，附加一个假设。新的核心模块 Becoming.Composition（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）加入一配置把两配置作为部分共同持有的关系（JointFrame），以及联合检验、联合相同、紧致、嵌套计划与足迹；Becoming.CompositionBridge 把 ExplanatoryJointness 与 ExplanatoryFootprints 读作实例。在部分可提升的描述处实现的计划，其叶所汲取者合起来无重复，且在所描述整体的足迹之内（JointPlan.supports_of_image）；code_plan_has_global_support 即提升与此定律的组合，在模型检验稳定处于脊柱上成立（code_plan_has_global_support_of_stable），稳定只用于提升一步，排中律给出之。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine, with one added hypothesis. The new core module Becoming.Composition, importing only Becoming.Likeness, adds the relation by which a configuration holds two configurations together as its parts (JointFrame), with joint tests, joint likeness, compactness, nested plans and footprints; Becoming.CompositionBridge reads ExplanatoryJointness and ExplanatoryFootprints as instances. Wherever a plan is realized at a description whose parts lift, what its leaves draw on, joined, repeats nothing and lies within the described whole's footprint (JointPlan.supports_of_image); code_plan_has_global_support is the lifting composed with this law and holds on the spine where the model's tests are stable (code_plan_has_global_support_of_stable), stability being used only by the lifting stage and given by excluded middle. Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.
